heading.title: First Division · Part V · Suits Relating to Immovable Property

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
Article66Twelve years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part V—Suits Relating to Immovable Property
For possession of immovable property when the plaintiff has become entitled to possession by reason of any forfeiture or breach of condition.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the forfeiture is incurred or the condition is broken.
